ignored.buttonTooltip: Choose locations that lists and decklist checks should never take cards from
ignored.intro: Lists won't count or pull cards from ticked locations. Use it for a sales binder, a deck in use, or a whole site. Find in collection still shows those cards, marked as ignored. Decklist checks skip them too.

delete.cardsQuestion: What should happen to the cards in these locations?
delete.moveToBulkHelp: The locations are removed. Every card in them is kept and moved to Bulk.
delete.deleteCardsHelp: Every card in these locations is permanently deleted along with them. This can't be undone.
delete.deleteCardsNoPermission: Needs permission to delete cards. Ask an administrator, or move the cards to Bulk.
delete.reviewIntro: Check every location below. Untick any you want to keep. Card counts include every game, not just the selected one.
delete.blockedRow: Its cards can't be deleted: some are listed for sale, on an open order or held at the kiosk.
delete.blocked: Some locations hold cards that are listed for sale, on an open order or held at the kiosk, so their cards can't be deleted. Untick those locations, or go Back and move the cards to Bulk.
delete.listedStayListed_one: {{count}} listed copy stays listed and moves to Bulk.
delete.listedStayListed_other: {{count}} listed copies stay listed and move to Bulk.
delete.listRefsLost_one: {{count}} list line points at these cards and will no longer find them.
delete.listRefsLost_other: {{count}} list lines point at these cards and will no longer find them.
delete.sealedKept_one: {{count}} sealed product lot stored here is kept, but will have no location.
delete.sealedKept_other: {{count}} sealed product lots stored here are kept, but will have no location.
delete.alsoRemoved: Binder dividers, put-back reports, deck links and saved views of these locations are removed with them.
